from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,re,os,hashlib
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1"
rx=re.compile(r"repo|dr007|funding|liquidity|money.?market|回购",re.I)
root=ROOT/"data/curated";visited=0;selected=[];limit_hit=False
for parent,dirs,files in os.walk(root):
 depth=len(Path(parent).relative_to(root).parts)
 if depth>=3:dirs[:]=[]
 for name in files:
  visited+=1
  if visited>3000:limit_hit=True;break
  p=Path(parent)/name
  if p.suffix.lower() in {".parquet",".csv"} and rx.search(str(p)):
   selected.append(p)
 if limit_hit:break
selected=sorted(selected)[:40]
views=[]
for p in selected:
 x={"path":p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),"bytes":p.stat().st_size}
 try:
  if p.suffix.lower()==".parquet":
   metadata=pq.read_metadata(p)
   x["columns"]=metadata.schema.names;x["rows"]=metadata.num_rows
  else:
   with p.open("r",encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:x["header"]=f.readline().strip()
  labels=x.get("columns",x.get("header",""))
  x["has_possible_quantity_column"]=bool(re.search(r"amount|volume|trdVol|成交量|成交额",str(labels),re.I))
 except Exception as e:x["schema_error_type"]=type(e).__name__
 views.append(x)
answer={"at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),"answer":"暂时没有","question":"是否已有可用Tushare或项目代理访问",
 "effective_state":"NO_VALID_ACCESS_AVAILABLE_FROM_USER","prior_result_pending_question_was_time_of_result_only":True,
 "does_not_pause_or_complete_goal":True,"new_payment_or_credential_bypass_not_authorized":True}
p=OUT/"用户访问答复_事实.json";assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(answer,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
inventory={"at":answer["at"],"scope":"仅data/curated深度≤3、最多3000文件、最多40个名字匹配的CSV/Parquet字段元数据；不读凭据、不扫全原始数据内容。",
 "visited_files":visited,"file_limit_hit":limit_hit,"selected_schema_files":len(views),"views":views,
 "scope_limit_not_whole_data_absence_proof":True,"new_source_requests":0,"new_fits":0}
p=OUT/"本地其他利率流动性数据_有限字段清单.json";assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(inventory,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"用户访问":"暂时没有","本地有界字段检查":len(views),"可能数量字段":[v for v in views if v.get("has_possible_quantity_column")],
 "利率相关字段":[v for v in views if re.search("dr007|repo",v["path"],re.I)],"扫描上限触发":limit_hit},ensure_ascii=False))
